{{short description|Theorem that the diffeomorphism group of the 3-sphere has the homotopy-type of O(4)}}
The '''Smale conjecture''', named after [[Stephen Smale]], is the statement that the [[diffeomorphism|diffeomorphism group]] of the [[3-sphere]] has the homotopy-type of its isometry group, the orthogonal group [[orthogonal group|O(4)]]. It was proved in 1983 by [[Allen Hatcher]].<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Hatcher|first=Allen E.|date=May 1983|title=A Proof of the Smale Conjecture, Diff(S<sup>3</sup>) ≃ O(4)|journal=The Annals of Mathematics|volume=117|issue=3|pages=553|doi=10.2307/2007035|jstor=2007035}}</ref>

== Equivalent statements ==

There are several equivalent statements of the Smale conjecture.  One is that the component of the unknot in the space of smooth embeddings of the circle in 3-space has the homotopy-type of the round circles, equivalently, [[orthogonal group|O(3)]].  Interestingly, this statement is not equivalent to the generalized Smale Conjecture, in higher dimensions. 

Another equivalent statement is that the group of diffeomorphisms of the [[Ball (mathematics)|3-ball]] which restrict to the identity on the boundary is contractible.

Yet another equivalent statement is that the space of constant-curvature Riemann metrics on the 3-sphere is contractible.

== Higher dimensions ==

The (false) statement that the inclusion <math> O(n+1) \to \text{Diff}(S^n) </math> is a weak equivalence for all <math>n</math> is sometimes meant when referring to the ''generalized Smale conjecture''. For <math> n = 1 </math>, this is classical, for <math> n = 2 </math>, Smale proved it himself.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Smale|first=Stephen|date=August 1959|title=Diffeomorphisms of the 2-Sphere|journal=Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society|volume=10|issue=4|pages=621–626|doi=10.2307/2033664|jstor=2033664}}</ref>

For <math>n\ge5</math> the conjecture is false due to the failure of <math>\text{Diff}(S^n)/O(n+1)</math> to be contractible.<ref>{{Cite web|first=Allen|last=Hatcher|date=2012|title=A 50 -Year View of Diffeomorphism Groups|url=https://pi.math.cornell.edu/~hatcher/Papers/Diff%28M%292012.pdf|journal=}}</ref>

In late 2018, Tadayuki Watanabe released a preprint that proves the failure of Smale's conjecture in the remaining 4-dimensional case<ref>{{cite arXiv|last=Watanabe|first=Tadayuki|date=2019-08-19|title=Some exotic nontrivial elements of the rational homotopy groups of Diff(S<sup>4</sup>)|class=math.GT |eprint=1812.02448}}</ref> relying on work around the [[Kontsevich integral]], a generalization of the [[Gauss linking integral]]. As of 2021, the proof remains unpublished in a mathematical journal.
